title: Breeze N' Rods
description: Adds a crafting recipe that allows players to craft wind charges back into breeze rods.
body:
# Breeze N' Rods
[![Download on Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/badge/Download-Modrinth-1bd96a?style=for-the-badge\&logo=modrinth\&logoColor=white)](https://modrinth.com/datapack/better-peaceful)
[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Join-Discord-5865F2?style=for-the-badge\&logo=discord\&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/xS85W48Cb3)
## Overview

**Breeze N' Rods** is a small quality-of-life datapack that adds a reverse crafting recipe for Wind Charges and Breeze Rods.

With this datapack installed, you can craft:

* **1 Breeze Rod** from **4 Wind Charges** 🌪️

In **vanilla Minecraft**, a Breeze Rod can be **crafted into Wind Charges**, but there is **no way to convert them back**. This datapack **fixes that** by adding a **simple reverse recipe**, allowing you to turn your **Wind Charges back into Breeze Rods** whenever you need them.

This is especially useful for **storage and organization**, as Breeze Rods can stack more efficiently and help **save valuable inventory** and **chest space**.

### Recipe:
![Recipe | 4 Wind Charges -> 1 Breeze Rod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bf646e1e04cb395b414caee07d96a8e8f47a1273.png)

### Features

**✔** **Adds** a **reverse crafting** recipe for Breeze Rods

**✔** **Helps save inventory** and **storage space**

**✔** **Vanilla-friendly** and **balanced**

**✔** **Multiplayer** compatible

**✔** **Lightweight** and **easy to install**

**✔** **No resource pack** required

### Installation

1. Download the datapack.
2. Place it in your world's `datapacks` folder.
3. Run `/reload` or restart the world.
4. Enjoy more convenient storage for your Wind Charges!

### Why Use This Datapack?

If you craft a lot of Wind Charges, they can quickly fill up your inventory and storage. Since Minecraft already allows Breeze Rods to be converted into Wind Charges, this datapack simply adds the missing reverse recipe, making the system more practical and consistent.

**Simple, useful, and fully vanilla-friendly.**
